verdict.rationale: Salv documents issuing API tokens through the OAuth2 client credentials flow and revoking them by deleting the client credentials in the UI. Nothing in the pack shows scopes, per-credential permission limits, or least-privilege roles for API clients. Plain credential issuance and revocation is an adjacent control, not the scoped-credential capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
